response.justification: Bogdan is a highly capable Staff Software Engineer with over 15 years of diverse, polyglot development and entrepreneurial experience. However, this Director-level Principal Engineer role requires deep, recognized expertise in AI strategy and platform architecture. His AI experience is very recent and primarily implementation-focused, falling short of the strategic, industry-leading AI qualifications and advanced academic credentials preferred for this specific position.
strengths: Exceeds the minimum requirement of 15 years of software, hardware, and infrastructure engineering experience.
Strong entrepreneurial background as the founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective).
Demonstrated passion for knowledge sharing and inspiring others through public workshops, talks, and mentoring.
concerns: AI experience is highly recent (starting in 2025) and lacks the recognized, director-level strategic depth required.
Does not possess the preferred advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an AI-related field.
Career history is heavily focused on hands-on IC implementation rather than high-level strategic advisory for enterprise customers.
